trust_decision.summary: Every file write performed by the SSG helper must land under the caller's output directory: saveContentToFile derives filePath with generateFilePath and calls ensureWithinOutDir before mkdir/writeFile. At the pinned commit that guard is a string-prefix test over paths normalized by joinPaths, whose consecutive-'..' handling pops only the first parent and pushes the rest literally, so a nested routePath such as a/b/../../../pwned still yields a string starting with the outDir name while the filesystem resolves outside it.

landing_point.why: The advisory summary says toSSG() still writes outside the output directory, so the first thing an engineer reads is generateFilePath, whose only guard is the ensureWithinOutDir call three lines after the joinPaths calls that build filePath; the guard itself lives one file away in utils.ts.
